column1: Application (refused certificate, withdrawn/refused application for conformity assessment)

column2: Keeps the information for an application (relating to a certificate refusal or a refused/withdrawn application for conformity assessment).
Describes the unique identification of an application (relating to a certificate refusal or a refused/withdrawn application for conformity assessment).

Specifies the actors to an application for a product conformity assessment procedure (relating to a certificate refusal or a refused/withdrawn application for conformity assessment), namely the manufacturer (MF) and the authorised representative (AR).

Specifies the actors to an application for a quality conformity assessment procedure (relating to a certificate refusal or a refused/withdrawn application for conformity assessment), namely the manufacturer (MF), the system or procedure pack provider and the authorised representative (AR).

column1: Certificate-Application (refused certificate, withdrawn/refused application for conformity assessment) Scope

column2: Denotes the scope of a certificate or an application (relating to a certificate refusal or a refused/withdrawn application for conformity assessment). It is further specialised for product and quality conformity assessment procedures.
Defines the devices in the scope of a product conformity assessment procedure.
Denotes the scope of a quality conformity assessment procedure.
Defines the information that need to be provided to include a device in the scope of a quality conformity assessment procedure.
Defines the information that need to be provided to include a device group in the scope of a quality conformity assessment procedure.
Defines the information that need to be provided to include a system or procedure pack (SPP) in the scope of a MDR quality conformity assessment procedure.
Defines the information that need to be provided to include a custom-made device (CMD) in the scope of a MDR quality conformity assessment procedure.
